test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held on: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In January 2022, the Supreme Court conferred daughters with equal right to the father’s property even prior to codification of Hindu Personal Laws and enactment of the Hindu Succession Act in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1956.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On 20 January 2022, the Supreme Court gave a judgment dealing with the property rights of Hindu women and widows under the Hindu Succession Act 1956 .
 
• Key points from the final verdict-
 
 
• The daughters of a male Hindu dying without a will would be entitled to inherit self-acquired and other properties obtained in the partition by the father.
 
• The daughters would get preference over other collateral members of the family such as sons and daughters of brothers of the deceased father.
 
• In case a female Hindu dies without leaving a will, the property she inherited from her father or mother would go to the heirs of her father while the property she inherited from her husband or father-in-law would go to the heirs of the husband.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Hindu Succession Act 1956 was enacted to amend and codify the law related to unwilled succession among Hindus, Jains, Sikhs, Buddhists.
 
• The act gives a uniform system according to which property of an unwilled deceased person is given.
 
• The act was amended in 2005 to give girls equal rights in the property.
